system.description: The Thuul softens up to 1 m³ of stone and shapes it for at least 3 minutes. It then hardens and retains its new shape for 1 hour(s) before returning to its original form. Apply this tracker after shaping is complete; its countdown starts then. The GM tracks terrain changes; this is not an aura.
system.summary: Temporarily softens stone so it can be shaped like clay.
